responsibility: Declares the `rustc_middle::middle` submodules, defines the `lib_features` shared data structures for tracking library feature stability by symbol, and wires this module’s query providers into the crate-level provider table.
same_name_distinction: Unlike roots such as `ty/mod.rs` or `mir/mod.rs` that define major core representations, this `mod.rs` mainly groups miscellaneous middle-layer analyses and shared data under one namespace, with its own notable in-file definition being `lib_features` rather than a central compiler model.
